## Problem

Fast, low-cost critique for short user-supplied text, followed by concrete repair actions.

## Inputs

Text to critique and optional roast style.

## Outputs

A roast, three practical fixes and a shareable result.

## Pricing

$0.99 USD one-time per roast.

- Single Roast: $0.99 (one_time)

## Invocation and authority

LIVE: agent HTTP gateway + OpenAPI + llms guidance + remote MCP at https://base44.app/api/apps/699732f3fcb10c954f3abac2/functions/roastedAgentMcp. Agents can read the 99¢ offer, prepare checkout only after explicit human confirmation, and retrieve the paid roast result. Generation requires Stripe verification of paid + complete + USD 0.99 + bound roast ID.

Explicit user confirmation is required before checkout. Paid output is generated only after independent Stripe verification.

Payment authority: ROASTED / Stripe, provider-verified

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
